description_zh:
把 AI Passport 变成随身宝可梦冒险。听完大木博士的介绍，从御三家或皮卡丘中选择伙伴，在森林、山洞、海边和电站寻找前 151 只宝可梦。

宣传片（约 3 分 43 秒，含赤红片段）：
https://github.com/Luobata/ESP32-PokemonGo/blob/main/reports/video/pokewalk-story-red-2026-09-09/pokewalk-story-v3.mp4
这是 9 月 9 日录制的故事版，包含开局、捕获、养成与挑战；尚未包含森林秘境，按键与部分规则以当前版本为准。

掌握投球时机，收集不同伙伴与闪光形态，组建六人队伍。照料影响成长和探索收益，进化、图鉴与成就还能带来道具奖励。十二位地图训练家可重复切磋，低等级队员有经验追赶，随后挑战道馆、四天王、冠军与赤红。现在也能带上自己培养的伙伴，进入连续闯关的森林秘境。

战斗自动从已学招式中出招，技能随成长解锁，无需管理 PP 或遗忘技能。配有像素动画、场景音乐、音量与静音控制，支持自动熄屏。统一使用体能安排日常冒险，约 1 小时从零恢复满。

探索根据周边 Wi-Fi 环境变化判断移动，不是真实计步。当前支持 191 种招式，并非完整金银复刻。非官方同人项目，名称、画面与音乐的素材来源见源码说明。

# 9 月 14 日：备份冒险，放心切换游戏

新增「菜单 → 选项 → 备份存档 / 导入存档」。通过电脑上的存档管理页，可把当前伙伴、仓库、图鉴、道具、养成、挑战、探索和秘境进度保存到自己选择的目录。每次生成独立备份，不自动删除旧文件，存档不上传服务器。

想体验其他游戏时，先完成备份，并保留对应的 PokeWalk 安装文件。之后在同一台设备装回同一固件构建，选择备份文件即可导入。当前只支持 PokeWalk，不是所有游戏通用的存档工具，也不支持跨版本或跨设备迁移。

导入需在设备二次确认，默认选中取消；确认后先自动保存一份当前进度，再开始导入。文件校验、传输中断保护和重启恢复校验已通过故障模拟测试与真机备份／导入验证。看到网页确认「存档导入完成」后再继续冒险。

需要桌面 Chrome / Edge，首次授权 USB 和本地目录。使用与部署说明：
https://github.com/Luobata/ESP32-PokemonGo/blob/main/tools/save-manager/README.md

首次升级本功能，旧版玩家请先备份再按说明升级；直接安装完整固件仍可能覆盖旧存档。本轮保留此前的体能恢复、仓库整理、森林秘境和成长体验。

# 9 月 13 日追加：体能加速与仓库整理

体能恢复加快一倍：每小时 100 点，约 36 秒恢复 1 点，从零约 1 小时回满。上限及各项行动消耗不变。

仓库长按 A 打开整理选项：可筛选闪光、当前可进化伙伴，按属性筛选，按图鉴编号或等级排序，也可快速翻页，每次跳过 5 只。A/B 移动、C 确认、长按 B 返回；不增加页码。清除筛选即可回到完整仓库，整理不改变伙伴或存档顺序。

秘境途中从仓库换宠，现在可以直接确认「结束并换入」，无需先退出去结束旅程。默认选中取消；确认后保留已经获得的经验与道具，结束当前秘境，再完成换入。入场体能不退，保存失败可重试。

# 9 月 13 日：带自己的伙伴挑战森林秘境

## 从自己的队伍出发

在「菜单 → 秘境」选择随行队伍中的 1～3 只伙伴，再确认「出发」。只有一只也能玩；继承实际等级、已学招式和闪光外观，不再使用固定等级的租借队伍。同种的不同伙伴可以分别选择，经验只发给本次选中的伙伴，升级或进化在下一场战斗生效。

一局共 8 个节点，包含守路者、路线分支、营地、精英与森林首领。对手等级按入场队伍最高等级调整，数量不超过本次伙伴数。HP 与异常状态在场间保留；营地可以回复、救助倒下的伙伴，或放弃回复换取强化。副本 HP 独立，不把局内伤害带回外面的伙伴。

共有 15 种局内强化，可组合属性印记、攻防提升、换人增伤、异常追击、击倒回血等效果。火、水、电印记按所选伙伴属性筛选，触发增伤或回复会显示反馈。

新开局消耗 20 点体能，继续旅程不重复收费；中途离开或重启也可继续。旅途中队伍排序仍锁定，仓库换宠可确认结束秘境后执行，确保奖励发给正确的伙伴。

## 每一段都有收获

- 战斗胜利获得伙伴经验，普通战还有概率获得精灵球或树果；奖励页显示经验、道具与本局累计收获。
- 精英战固定获得树果 ×3、超级球 ×2，首次击败精英额外获得牛奶 ×1。
- 首领固定掉落高级球 ×2，首次通关额外获得叶之石 ×1；后续通关有机会获得进化石或通讯机器。
- 累计通关 3 次获得通讯机器，10 次获得进化机器；入口显示下一个奖励目标。
- 遗迹补给分支可回复 HP，并获得树果和阶段经验；选择迎战则有额外强化机会。
- 已经结算的经验和道具，失败或主动结束后仍然保留。入场费不退，尚未通过的节点不提前发奖；保存失败可以重试，避免重复扣费或领奖。

## 只保留一套体能

取消 24/24 探索情报、额外储备和相关进度条，原有情报加成并入基础探索收益。图鉴追踪、章节解锁、剧情线索和地点发现继续保留。

体能上限 100，约 36 秒恢复 1 点，约 1 小时从零回满。开机与熄屏待机均可恢复，完全关机暂不补算；主页显示体能和预计回满时间。

- 普通探索、路线训练家切磋：5 点。
- 道馆、强化重赛、赤红：10 点。
- 四天王与冠军：整轮 20 点，入场扣一次。
- 森林秘境：新开局 20 点，继续不再扣。
- 已发现野怪的战斗与捕获：不新增入场费。

修复选好伙伴、点击「出发」后异常重启并回到首页的问题，已在设备上复测入场流程。

# 最近几轮更新继续保留

## 9 月 11 日：完整进化演出与战斗节奏

等级、石头和机器进化共用独立演出：原形态展示、轮廓交替加速、新形态揭示、光球扩散，再按 C 继续。主动画约 8.5 秒，前后接对应形态的叫声与配套音乐；保留闪光外观、摆动、音量和静音控制。进化提交前可长按 B 取消，保存失败可重试。

修复游戏和预览中的技能动画慢放，保留回合间停顿。训练家换宠、倒下替补与回复列表显示等级及当前／最大 HP。体能恢复调整至约 2 小时回满。

## 9 月 10 日：操作、成长与日常体验

统一 A 上、B 下、C 确认、长按 B 返回；修复误返回、长按后触发短按。捕获时 A/B 切换球，C 立即投球；逃跑与认输需要确认。

恢复主页及训练家／道馆战经验条，增加战后经验增长动画与升级学招提示，分享经验升级也会提示。所有招式自动学会，无需遗忘或 PP 管理。

等级进化只按等级判断，不再额外要求亲密度或探索值。妙蛙种子 16 级、妙蛙草 32 级即可进化；已有伙伴超过门槛也适用。设为队首，在「照料 → 进化」确认，仍可选择暂不进化。

照料玩耍需至少 5 点体能，体能不足仍可消耗树果喂食。重复挑战与体能联动，战败扣心情、不扣经验；低体能不再额外降低伤害。修复体能取整、重复扣费和重复发经验问题。

历史说明中的「探索还需次数」「最多 24 点情报加成」「5 分钟恢复 1 点体能」已被本版规则替代。

# 升级与体验范围

旧伙伴、图鉴、道具和正式进度兼容；旧租借秘境体验需要重新选择自己的伙伴开局。安装方式仍可能覆盖存档，更新前请备份进度。森林秘境是首个可玩版本，目前只有一张八节点地图，欢迎反馈难度与奖励平衡。

description_en:
A pocket Pokémon adventure: meet Professor Oak, choose a starter or Pikachu and explore four areas for the first 151 Pokémon.

Story video (3m43s, including Red):
https://github.com/Luobata/ESP32-PokemonGo/blob/main/reports/video/pokewalk-story-red-2026-09-09/pokewalk-story-v3.mp4
Recorded September 9, before the Forest dungeon; controls and some rules have since changed.

Catch shiny Pokémon, raise a party of six and earn milestone rewards. Train against twelve route opponents, then challenge Gyms, the Elite Four, the Champion and Red, or take your partners into the Forest dungeon.

Automatic learned moves, no PP or forgetting; pixel animation, scene music, volume, mute and screen sleep. Shared stamina refills in about one hour.

Movement is inferred from nearby Wi-Fi changes, not step counting. Includes 191 moves; this is not a complete Gold/Silver recreation. An unofficial fan project, with artwork, music and naming sources credited in the repository.

September 14: Keep your adventure when trying other games

Menu > Options now includes Save Backup and Import Save. The desktop save manager writes your partners, box, Pokédex, items, care, challenges, exploration and dungeon progress into a folder you choose. Each backup is a separate file, old backups are not deleted, and saves never upload to the server.

Before trying another game, finish a backup and keep its matching PokeWalk installer. Reinstall the exact same PokeWalk firmware build on the same device to import it later. This tool currently supports PokeWalk only, not arbitrary games, cross-version migration or transfers between devices.

Import requires confirmation on the device, with Cancel selected by default. Your current progress is backed up first. File checks, interrupted transfers and reboot recovery have been tested, including a real-device export/import round trip. Wait for the confirmed import-complete message before continuing.

Use desktop Chrome / Edge and grant USB and local-folder access. Setup and usage:
https://github.com/Luobata/ESP32-PokemonGo/blob/main/tools/save-manager/README.md

Existing players must back up before installing this feature for the first time; a full firmware install may overwrite previous progress. This update retains the recent stamina, box, Forest dungeon and growth improvements.

September 13 follow-up: Faster recovery and box browsing

Stamina now recovers 100 points per hour: about 36 seconds per point, one hour from empty. Capacity and action costs are unchanged.

Hold A in the box to filter shiny or currently evolvable partners, filter by type, sort by Pokédex number or level, or jump five entries at a time. A/B navigate, C confirms and hold B returns. No page numbers. Filters do not rearrange saved partners.

Box swaps during a dungeon run now offer End and swap, with Cancel selected by default. Confirming keeps earned EXP and items, ends the run and swaps partners. Entry stamina is not refunded; failed saves can be retried.

September 13: Enter the Forest with your own partners

Open Menu > Dungeon, select 1–3 members of your current party and confirm Depart. One partner is enough. Their actual levels, learned moves and shiny appearance carry over; there is no fixed-level rental team. EXP goes only to selected participants, with growth or evolution reflected in the next battle.

Each run has eight nodes: battles, forks, camps, an elite and a Forest boss. Opponents scale from the highest entry level, with no more opponents than selected partners. HP and status carry between battles. Camps offer recovery, revival or an upgrade instead. Dungeon damage does not carry back to your partners outside the run.

Combine 15 upgrades, including elemental marks, attack and defense boosts, stronger attacks after switching, status follow-ups and healing after knockouts. Fire, Water and Electric marks are filtered by your selected partners' types. Damage and healing bonuses show feedback.

Starting a run costs 20 stamina once. Leaving the screen or restarting allows you to continue without paying again. Party order stays locked during a run; box swaps offer to end it first.

Rewards along the way

- Winning battles grants partner EXP. Normal battles may also drop Poké Balls or berries. Reward screens show EXP, items and your accumulated haul.
- Elite wins guarantee 3 berries and 2 Great Balls; your first elite win also grants 1 Milk.
- The boss grants 2 Ultra Balls. Your first clear adds a Leaf Stone; later clears may award evolution stones or a Link Machine.
- Three clears guarantee a Link Machine, and ten a Growth Machine. The entrance shows your next milestone.
- The ruins supply fork heals HP and grants berries and stage EXP. Choosing combat offers an extra upgrade opportunity.
- Settled EXP and items remain yours after defeat or retirement. Entry stamina is not refunded, and unfinished nodes do not pay rewards. Failed saves can be retried without duplicate charges or rewards.

One stamina system

Removed the 24/24 exploration intel balance, extra reserves and their progress bars. Previous intel bonuses are included in base exploration rewards. Pokédex tracking, chapters, story clues and discovered locations remain.

Stamina caps at 100 and recovers about one point every 36 seconds, or a full refill in one hour. Recovery works while running or in screen-off standby, not while fully powered off. Home shows stamina and time to full.

Exploration and route training cost 5; Gyms, rematches and Red cost 10; an Elite Four and Champion run costs 20 once; a new Forest run costs 20, with no charge to continue. Previously discovered wild battles and captures have no extra entry fee.

Fixed the restart that returned players home after selecting partners and pressing Depart. Entry was retested on the device.

Previous updates retained

September 11: Dedicated level, stone and machine evolution scenes with silhouettes, a reveal, lights, species cries and music. The main animation lasts about 8.5 seconds. Hold B before commitment to cancel; failed saves can be retried. Fixed slow move playback; trainer partner lists show levels and HP.

September 10: A up, B down, C confirm and hold B back; fixed accidental returns. Capture uses A/B to select balls and C to throw. Escape and surrender require confirmation. Restored EXP bars, animated battle EXP and level-up move notices. Level evolution no longer needs extra friendship or exploration: set a partner as leader and select Care > Evolution. Playing costs 5 stamina; feeding still works at low stamina. Defeat costs mood, not EXP. Fixed duplicate charges and rewards.

Old exploration chances, 24-point intel bonuses and five-minute stamina recovery are superseded by the current rules.

Existing partners, Pokédex, items and main progress remain compatible. Old rental dungeon runs need a fresh selection of your own partners. Installation can still overwrite saves; back up progress before updating. This first playable dungeon has one eight-node map. Feedback on difficulty and rewards is welcome.

Full release notes and earlier versions:
https://github.com/Luobata/ESP32-PokemonGo/blob/main/reports/release-notes-2026-09-13.md
